title: AION Development System — Team Edition
date_basis: Selected November 1981 scenario launch day; not a sourced historical COMDEX opening date.
status: Offering and campaign accepted; market reaction and financial integration deferred.
financial_boundary: Budgets below are proposed program investment inputs only. Do not add to existing totals until overlap with already funded software, marketing, equipment and support is reconciled. Sales, investment and ROI outputs remain frozen at 574ed9. Their source hashes intentionally describe the previous inputs.

license.unit: one server, four concurrent developer sessions
license.renewal: No automatic paid renewal assumed; first-year support capped at 12 staff-hours. Further work quoted separately.
license.expansion: Additional concurrency packs planned, not priced or counted as shipping offers.

delivery.note: One combined package; do not add its client/server editions or old IDE/SDK to its cost. Development/NRE excluded from unit cost.

campaign_message: Complex products. Whole teams. One development environment.
campaign_promise: Your team’s development environment should outlast any single computer architecture.
claim_policy: Robustness is a design goal demonstrated by recovery and reproducible builds, not an untested most-robust comparison. No write-once/run-anywhere or Apple/Commodore launch claim.

pending_investment_costs.basis: 6 QA equivalents × 10 months × $3,000 loaded monthly allowance
3 technical writers × 8 months × $2,500 loaded monthly allowance

campaign_costs.basis: 6 pilots × $5,000 deployment/demo allowance; no sales conversion assumed
3 months × $25,000; no leads or sales uplift assumed

assumptions: All staffing, hours, prices and campaign allowances are explicit alternative-history planning assumptions, not supplier quotes or historical facts.
